Name: Vishal Garg
Designation: Director, Indorama Ventures Center for Clean Energy
Bio: Prof Vishal Garg is a University Chair Professor and Director of the Indorama Ventures Center for Clean Energy at Plaksha University. He works with policymakers to translate building-energy research into practical measures for reducing heat and energy use. His teaching includes building energy simulation, green buildings, and illumination engineering.
Education: PhD, Centre for Energy Studies (IIT Delhi)
Research_Summary:
Prof Garg's research develops strategies and technologies for energy-efficient, comfortable, and climate-resilient buildings. His work combines building simulation, field monitoring, controls, and studies of occupant behaviour, with a focus on reducing residential cooling demand and mitigating urban heat.

Areas of work:

Cool roofs and reflective surfaces for urban heat mitigation

Building energy informatics and simulation

Smart homes and energy management systems

Decarbonising residential cooling

Indoor thermal comfort and occupant behaviour
Research_Interests: Building Energy Informatics | Smart Energy Homes | Cool Surfaces for Urban Heat Island Mitigation | Decarbonising Residential AC Energy Consumption | Energy Efficient and Smart Buildings
